outages.purpose: BEL to install protective devices on the distribution system and replace utility poles in Columbia Village to improve the reliability of power supply to our Customers in the area
outages.raw_text:
Load Center: Punta Gorda 
Feeder: 2
Zone: 2 & Portion 1
Areas to be affected: Columbia, San Miguel, Mafredi, Jordan, Blue Creek, Aguacate, San Antonio and Crique Jute.
